mapper.sql: qpt.Qsp_Id Qsp_Id, qpt.P_ID pId, qpt.Con_Id conId, qpt.Pt_Contractor_Id ptContractorId, qpt.Pt_Supervisor_Id ptSupervisorId, qpt.Pt_Pm ptPm, qpt.Pt_Cse ptCse, qpt.Pt_Group_Leader ptGroupLeader, qpt.Pt_Team_Leader ptTeamLeader, qpt.Pt_Group_Member ptGroupMember, qpt.Pt_Evaluation_Time ptEvaluationTime, qpt.Pt_Evaluation_Unit_Id ptEvaluationUnitId, qpt.Pt_Last_Construction ptLastConstruction, qpt.Pt_Construction ptConstruction, qpt.Pt_Description ptDescription, qpt.Pt_Mrq ptMrq, qpt.Pt_Evaluation_Result ptEvaluationResult, qpt.Pt_Group_leader_Name ptGroupLeaderName, qpt.Pt_Team_Leader_Name ptTeamLeaderName, qpt.Pt_Group_Member_Name ptGroupMemberName, qpt.Pt_Problem_Count ptProblemCount, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Require_Time ptRectifyRequireTime, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Cid ptRectifyCid, qpt.Pt_Finish_Count ptFinishCount, qpt.Pt_Problem_Report ptProblemReport, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Report ptRectifyReport, qpt.Pt_Type ptType, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Time ptRectifyTime, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Remark ptRectifyRemark, qpt.Pt_Code ptCode, qpt.Pt_Pitfall ptPitfall, qpt.Pt_Reply ptReply, qpt.Pt_Category ptCategory, qpt.Pt_Measure Pt_Measure, qpt.Pt_Is_Construction ptIsConstruction, qpt.Pt_Concrete ptConcrete, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Reply ptRectifyReply, qpt.Pt_Notice_Type ptNoticeType, qpt.Pt_Problem ptProblem, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Suggest ptRectifySuggest, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Limit_Time ptRectifyLimitTime, qpt.Pt_Rectify_Person ptRectifyPerson
mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, qt.Qst_Name as qstName, qt.Qst_Code as qstCode, qt.Qst_Item as qstItem, qt.Qst_Is_Important as qstIsImportant, c1.C_Name as qsrDutyCpyName, u1.U_Name as rectifyUname, mn.* from Qs_Record mn left join Qs_Type qt on qt.Qst_Id = mn.Qst_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Qsr_Duty_Cpy left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id = mn.Qsr_Rectify_Uid left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Qsr_Id where mn.Pt_Id = #{id} order by mn.Qsr_Create_Time ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, c1.C_Name as ptContractorName, c1.C_Abbreviation as ptContractorAbbName, c2.C_Name as ptSupervisorName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ptSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Name as ptEvaluationUnitName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ptEvaluationUnitAbbName, c4.C_Name as ptRectifyName, c4.C_Abbreviation as ptRectifyAbbName, u1.U_Name as ptPmName, u2.U_Name as ptCseName, qp.Qsp_Code as qspCode, qp.Qsp_Name as qspName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Qs_Plan_Task mn left join Qs_Plan qp on qp.Qsp_Id = mn.Qsp_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Pt_Contractor_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Pt_Supervisor_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = mn.Pt_Evaluation_Unit_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id = mn.Pt_Rectify_Cid left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id = mn.Pt_Pm left join Sys_User u2 on u2.U_Id = mn.Pt_Cse left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.Id = #{id}

select sum(t.a) as qsPlanTaskCount, sum(t.b) as qsRecordCount, sum(t.c) as qsFinishCount from( select (select count(*) from Qs_Plan_Task qpt where qpt.P_Id=mn.P_Id and qpt.State!=3 ) as a, (select count(*) from Qs_Record rec left join Qs_Plan_Task qpt on qpt.id=rec.Pt_Id where qpt.P_Id=mn.P_Id and rec.Qsr_State!=3) as b, (select count(*) from Qs_Record rec left join Qs_Plan_Task qpt on qpt.id=rec.Pt_Id where qpt.P_Id=mn.P_Id and rec.Qsr_State!=3 and rec.Qsr_Rectify_Status='03') as c from Pre_Project mn ${params.authSql}
) t

select qpt.*, U_ID as uId, U_Name as uName, U_MTel as uPhone, pp.P_Name as pName from Qs_Plan_Task qpt left join Qs_Record qr on qr.Pt_Id=qpt.id left join Pre_Project pp on pp.P_ID=qpt.P_ID left join Qs_Record_Duty qrd on qrd.Qsr_Id=qr.Qsr_Id left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=qrd.Qrd_User_Id where qpt.State!=7 and qpt.State!=3 and qr.Qsr_Rectify_Status!='03'

con.Con_Approval_State not in('0','3') and con.Con_Category='1'

#{item}

and qr.Qsr_State!=3
